title: Additional debt restriction and permitted-debt exception

agreement.pdf.source_wording: The Borrower shall not incur any additional Indebtedness, except Permitted Debt.

referenced_definitions.definition_text: Permitted Debt means Indebtedness outstanding on the Closing Date and purchase-money debt not exceeding INR 2 crore in aggregate.
